if: the supply is an export of goods or services
then: the invoice MUST carry the prescribed export endorsement, and MUST carry, in place of the rule 46(e) details, the recipient's name and address, the address of delivery, and the name of the country of destination
note: Two endorsements exist: one for supplies made on payment of integrated tax, one for supplies made under bond or Letter of Undertaking without payment of integrated tax.

evidence.quote: Provided also that in the case of the export of goods or services, the invoice shall carry an endorsement
SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT/SUPPLY TO SEZ UNIT OR SEZ DEVELOPER FOR AUTHORISED OPERATIONS ON PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX
evidence.extraction_note: The endorsement stands between the extraction's U+2015 and U+2016 quotation marks and is quoted without them.

evidence.quote: SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT/SUPPLY TO SEZ UNIT OR SEZ DEVELOPER FOR AUTHORISED OPERATIONS UNDER BOND OR LETTER OF UNDERTAKING WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX
evidence.extraction_note: Quoted without the surrounding U+2015 / U+2016 quotation marks, as above.
